description: This file defines the 'SecondMoment' class, which computes the second central moment of a dataset, i.e., the sum of squared deviations from the mean. It extends the 'FirstMoment' class and provides methods for updating the moment with new data, copying instances, and retrieving results.

classes.name: SecondMoment
classes.description: A class for calculating the second central moment (variance-related measure) of a dataset, supporting incremental updates.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adds a new data value to the moment calculation and updates internal state.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state to start a new calculation.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current value of the second moment (sum of squared deviations).

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of this SecondMoment instance.
